environment.description: Jenkins CI/CD server running the artifact plugin directly on port 8443, exposed to internal network. No reverse proxy or API gateway in front. The plugin runs as the jenkins user which has read access to /etc/shadow, /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/, and SSH keys. PIPELINE_API_KEY is set to a known shared secret distributed to all pipeline jobs.

config.network: internal corporate network, no ingress filtering
config.proxy: none - direct access to Flask app
config.filesystem_access: read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, jenkins secrets directory
